plainText:
Grandpa Forest (Japanese: のおじいちゃん Grandpa Forest) is a that lives on Melemele Island and is a recurring Pokémon character in Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon.

==History==
In the past, Grandpa Forest met and soon after they first met and became friends. When they first encountered Grandpa Forest, they were scared off. Grandpa Forest eventually reappeared when Lana and Mallow fell off a cliff and saved them. This led to Lana and Mallow becoming friends with Grandpa Forest.

 
In Tasting the Bitter with the Sweet!, Lana informed about an encounter that her sisters had whilst in the forest when they got lost. This led Mallow and Lana to remember when Grandpa Forest saved them and they believed it was the same Pokémon. After school, accompanied Lana and Mallow into the forest as they recalled their adventure. eventually concluded that Grandpa Forest was a Drampa based on the description. They soon encountered Grandpa Forest, who was happy to see them. Soon after, , who had been spying on Ash, Mallow, and Lana, showed up, dressed in apparel in an attempt to woo Grandpa Forest. Grandpa Forest didn't believe their ruse and attempted to fly off, only to be captured in a net fired by . Infuriated, Grandpa Forest easily freed itself and attacked Team Rocket, who was promptly saved by . Lana thanked Grandpa Forest for saving her sisters and they spent some time together.

In Don't Ignore the Small Stufful!, Grandpa Forest listened to , only to fall , much to Jigglypuff's annoyance.

In A Recipe for Success!, Grandpa Forest was among the customers who visited Oranguru's place while Mallow was assisting . Mallow presented it with a Haban Berry meal, remembering its preference for those particular Berries, and Grandpa Forest enjoyed it.

In Spying for the Big Guy!, Team Rocket attempted to capture Grandpa Forest to give to Matori after she arrived in Alola to take Bewear. After luring Grandpa Forest to them with Haban Berries, Team Rocket sent out to battle it, but as Mimikyu was only interested in battling , it refused to fight. James then sent out , and they were about to attack Grandpa Forest with when Bewear and showed up and brought them back to their hideout.

==Personality and characteristics==
Grandpa Forest is a solitary but friendly Pokémon, especially towards young children, as seen in Tasting the Bitter with the Sweet!, where it helped save , , Harper, and Sarah. Grandpa Forest can be ferocious, though it only reserves its aggression for troublesome individuals like . Its favorite food is Haban Berries.
